captures.description: Logotic Programming v0.4 as a third regime beside instruction-to-execution and objective-to-optimization: semantic conditions, traversal, stabilization. Reads the persistent-anchor requirement as a remedy for semantic drift, the impossible-input substitution rule as turning failure into specification, and the form as the argument. Reaches Symbolon and the Morrow-Fraction division of labour: when meaning is allowed to move, against how it moves.
